1788265.name: Chabad Jewish Center
1788265.note: COLlive, 11 March 2015 ('New Shluchim to Central Florida'): the Friedmans 'were recruited by Rabbi Moshe and Libby Lazaros, who established Chabad in Lakeland 5 years ago' (count back: about 2010). The chabad.org listing (1788265) is from about 2012. Count-back only: medium.

2781552.name: Jewish Learning Center
2781552.note: COLlive, 11 March 2015: Rabbi Mendel and Chaya Friedman 'have been appointed as the new Shluchim and directors of the recently opened Jewish Learning Center in Winter Haven, Florida', moving there after Pesach 2015, recruited by Rabbi Moshe and Libby Lazaros of Chabad of Lakeland; today Rabbi Moshe Lazaros directs it. So open by March 2015 ('recently'); the chabad.org listing (2781552) is from about 2014.

604076.name: The Gan Frida
604076.note: Sun-Sentinel (CrownHeights.info, 17 Dec 2007), on Rabbi Alexander Kaller's Chabad Russian Center in Sunny Isles Beach: 'In August, the center opened a Jewish-Russian preschool in North Miami.' The Gan Frida (2221 NE 171st Street, North Miami Beach) is that preschool, run by Chanie and Rabbi Alexander Kaller; directory profiles agree it was founded in 2007, by the Chabad Russian Center. The chabad.org listing (604076) is from about 2007.

6788826.name: Chabad of East Tampa
6788826.note: St. Petersburg Times (CrownHeights.info, 12 June 2007): 'Rabbi Uriel Rivkin runs a Chabad house in Temple Terrace near the University of South Florida'; COL (16 Oct 2007) has Uriel Rivkin, 31, overseeing Young Israel of Tampa's USF branch. Today's Chabad of East Tampa (Young Israel – Chabad East Tampa, 13207 N 52nd Street, Temple Terrace) is the Rivkins' (Rabbi Uriel and Dvora); the chabad.org listing (6788826) is new, about 2025. So there by 2007; its start not found.

118271.name: Jewish Learning Center Ohr Menachem Mendel Resource Library Chabad
118271.note: CrownHeights.info, 5 June 2006: a Shavuot-night lecture 'at the Jewish Learning Center of Miami Beach'; 'The JLC is headed by Rabbi Yossi and Rochel Gordon.' Today's listing (JLConline.org; 411 West 41st Street, the Captain Hyman P. Galbut Jewish Learning Center) has Rabbi Aron Rabin as program director. So there by June 2006; its start not found (therebbesimpact.com says 1998: a lead only).
